description:
we concluded our 3rd Financial Literacy Program ( FLP) Camp for Domestic workers on August 21st and 22nd at Lodha Fiorenza, Goregaon

Many thanks to Rtn. Payal Nakra who kindly arranged the permissions for the venue. Our implementation partner was Suryodaya Foundation.

Project Lead - Rtn.Jyoti Shiralee

This flagship initiative is aimed at creating financial awareness among domestic workers and security/ housekeeping staff on various financial and saving instruments and enabling them to enrol them for availing various Govt social and health security schemes

Camp Outcomes

*Beneficiaries- 146
Abha Card - 95
E-Shram card 42
Ayushman card 21
